title: Mystery House
opening_scene: Will Howard Crane hire these people, and which Boston lead do they take first?
one_liner: Boston, 1920: landlord Howard Crane hires investigators for a house that will not stay rented. Official rule-gym: every lead site is stocked with CoC7 settle hooks.
win_condition: End the Crowe House haunting by destroying Calvin Crowe's body in the basement (best: his own ritual knife, then fire), or leave Boston. Endings: gym-ending-ash / gym-ending-fled.
summary: 1920sBoston，房东Howard Crane请人去查一栋租不出去的老宅。官用测试模组：每个调查点都埋了规则图谱细钩，剧情只负责把人送到出事的地方。
player_safe_summary: Autumn 1920, Boston. Landlord Howard Crane has a house nobody will re-let. The last tenants, the Costas, left for an asylum. Neighbors call it Crowe House. Crane pays by the day; keys and the address are available at once. He is also an unsubtle magician and will teach. A chase drill sits behind his office. The city leads — clipping morgue, library, records, police, alley gossip, former tenants, chapel ruins — are where injury, SAN, fights, a boarding-house rest, a clinic, and a ward can happen.
keeper_secret_summary: Calvin Crowe's corpse is sealed behind a basement partition; his will still drives the body. Mystery House is the in-house rule-gym, not a Chaosium reprint. Crane teaches Flesh Ward / Dominate / Shriveling. Hooks: clipping stack / blotter nail / parlor deadfall = injury; library plate / Dooley's story / Maria's stare / chapel familiar = SAN; Mrs. Hale = safe rest; clinic = first aid/medicine; ward = treatment; chapel familiar = combat+chase; Hatch opposed check; combined library search; jammed door = luck/push; killing the familiar = SAN gain.
